statement: You receive one line holding a valid expression that may mix letters, digits, operators and round brackets. Print its nesting depth: the largest number of bracket pairs open at a single moment. Scan once, raise a counter on every (, lower it on every ), and record the highest value the counter reaches. Only brackets drive the counter; every other character passes through untouched.
constraints: All brackets in the expression are balanced.

example.why: The 8 sits inside three open pairs; at no moment are four pairs open.

hint: The answer is the counter's peak; its final value only confirms balance.
mistake: Reporting the counter's final value - balance makes that 0 for every valid input.
